# Les Copines

> PR and creator relations for hotels, restaurants and brands with heart. A small agency in Berlin.

Les Copines is a PR and creator relations agency in Kreuzberg, Berlin. The name is French for "the girlfriends". It works for hotels, restaurants, health and wellbeing brands in Berlin, Ibiza and the countryside in between. The client list is small, the relationships are long, and every introduction is made in person.

## Services

- Public relations: press strategy, releases and pitching to travel, food and lifestyle desks.
- Creator relations: hand-picked creators and journalists, invited to stay, eat and write.
- Press dinners and openings: previews, launches and dinners. Guest lists built one name at a time.
- Social media: Instagram planning and captions in German and English.

## Selected work

- [Nômade Temple](https://lescopines.de/#case-nomade): hotel and wellbeing resort, Ibiza, 2026
- [Park am See](https://lescopines.de/#case-parkamsee): Nattika Ayurveda resort, Mecklenburg, 2026
- [Ayurveda Day Retreat](https://lescopines.de/#case-retreat): Nattika Ayurveda and Neue Wege Reisen, Berlin, 2026
- [Restaurant Week](https://lescopines.de/#case-rw): food festival, second edition, Berlin, 2026
- [ROOT Bistro](https://lescopines.de/#case-root): restaurant in Hotel Telegraphenamt, Berlin-Mitte, 2025
- [Heritage](https://lescopines.de/#case-heritage): restaurant in Hotel Luc, Berlin, 2026
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lescopines.agency/): more work

## Languages

German, English, French.
